= Ordered list sequence scope

== Start stays with its list

[lowerroman,start=5]
. Five
. Six
[loweralpha]
.. Child A
.. Child B
.. Child C
. Seven

== Reversed stays with its list

[%reversed]
. Two
.. Child A
.. Child B
. One

== Nested lists keep their own sequence

[start=3]
. Three
[%reversed]
.. Child B
.. Child A
. Four

[%reversed]
. Two
[start=4]
.. Child D
.. Child E
. One

== Deeper lists reset too

[start=7]
. Seven
* Bullet
... Grandchild i
... Grandchild ii
. Eight

== Later lists start fresh

. One
. Two
